@bdraco it seems both `mqtt` and `mqtt_statestream` are set up at stage 2. With the dependency `mqtt` will be set up first. The only scenario I can think of is that the setup of MQTT is not successful at the time `mqtt_statestream` is initialized.
`hass.data["setup_done"]["mqtt"]` is not set before the `mqtt` entry has been started. After setup the `mqtt` key is removed from `hass.data["setup_done"]`. Then the only check that is performed is that the mqtt entry has `LOADED` state. Somehow that seems not to be the case. @balloob May be you have some suggestions here?

@jbouwh,  I did more troubleshooting. If I run homeassistant 2023.4.2 with the mqtt_statestream component from 2023.3.6 (as custom_component) everything works OK.  So problem is definitely in the 2023.4.x mqtt_statestream component.

I have two instances of HA which share some sensor states over MQTT via mqtt_statestream.

Instance (A) is the main MQTT broker, and publishes sensor states via mqtt_statestream.
Instance (B) has MQTT configured to use (A) as broker and also publishes sensor states via mqtt_statestream.

Both instances, (A) and (B), are on HA version 2023.4.4
(A) is running perfectly fine.
(B) on the other hand, displays the same errors as @Hackashaq666 mentioned in the first post.

Hope this info is useful.
